title: Hadoop YARN ResourceManager Unauthenticated RCE
description: A Hadoop 2.8.1 cluster (HDFS and YARN) without Kerberos: the ResourceManager REST API on port 8088 lets anyone create and submit an application whose container command runs on the NodeManager.
question: Submit a YARN application through the unauthenticated ResourceManager API to run commands on the NodeManager and read /ctf/flag.
